stories.title: 9月19日北京部分区域将试鸣防空警报 学会分辨这个声音，很关键！

en.title: Beijing to conduct air raid siren test in some areas on September 19
en.summary: Beijing will test air raid sirens in certain districts on September 19. Residents are urged to learn how to distinguish this warning sound.

stories.title: ‘Lazy economy’: US$15 monthly rubbish services in China gain popularity, benefitting elderly

en.title: 'Lazy economy': US$15 monthly rubbish services in China gain popularity, benefitting elderly
en.summary: Young entrepreneurs in China are offering paid garbage disposal services to customers, with fees ranging from 45 to 75 cents per pickup or approximately $15 monthly. The service has gained traction, particularly among elderly residents.

stories.title: ‘Doing a North Korea’? Why the Middle East could be entering a new nuclear age

en.title: 'Doing a North Korea'? Why the Middle East could be entering a new nuclear age
en.summary: Saudi Arabia is set to receive American uranium enrichment technology while Turkey pursues similar capabilities, as Iran considers withdrawing from a nuclear treaty. The US and Israel have threatened additional strikes on Iranian nuclear facilities, citing concerns about program revival.

stories.title: Has a Chinese DF missile been used for the first time in the Middle East?

en.title: Has a Chinese DF missile been used for the first time in the Middle East?
en.summary: Debris from a Chinese DF-15A short-range ballistic missile was discovered in Yemen, marking the first time such a weapon has been found there and potentially indicating Chinese weapons systems were used in the Saudi-Houthi conflict.

stories.title: 出境游市场扩容，签证告知、格式条款成纠纷高发区

en.title: Outbound tourism market expands; visa notices and standard terms become dispute hotspots
en.summary: A consumer who paid over 300,000 yuan for a high-end multi-country tour in Central and South America was unable to travel as scheduled due to incorrect visa requirements provided by the travel agency. After coordination, the consumer received a full refund of over 300,000 yuan.

stories.title: 今年前八月重庆外贸规模创历史同期新高

en.title: Chongqing's foreign trade volume reaches record high in first eight months of the year
en.summary: Chongqing's total foreign trade import and export value reached 658.77 billion yuan in the first eight months of 2026, achieving a record high for the same period with a year-on-year growth of 29.7%.

stories.title: 首个民族团结进步宣传周活动将在全国开展

en.title: First National Ethnic Unity and Progress Publicity Week to be Held Nationwide
en.summary: China will hold its first ethnic unity and progress publicity week in 2026, with relevant government departments briefing media on the initiative in Beijing.

stories.title: As the American century ends, Asia’s renaissance begins

en.title: As the American century ends, Asia's renaissance begins
en.summary: The United States remains the world's largest economy but no longer dominates globally, while Asia's fastest-growing economies are rising. American trade policies are prompting partners to seek alternative investment and trade opportunities.

stories.title: Chinese firms’ export share to reach 31% by 2035 as global expansion deepens: Goldman Sachs

en.title: Chinese firms' export share to reach 31% by 2035 as global expansion deepens: Goldman Sachs
en.summary: Goldman Sachs projects Chinese companies will increase their average export market share to 31 percent by 2035 from 18 percent currently, with revenues expected to grow 3.6-fold over the same period across 40 global firms.

stories.title: Unitree’s US$30 billion stock wipe-off spurs regulatory caution on humanoid robot IPOs

en.title: Unitree's US$30 billion stock wipe-off spurs regulatory caution on humanoid robot IPOs
en.summary: Chinese humanoid robot maker Unitree Robotics has declined over 40 percent since listing, prompting Beijing regulators to consider stricter scrutiny of similar initial public offerings focusing on revenue sustainability and innovation capabilities.

stories.title: Chinese carmakers GAC and FAW eye potential tie-up of their Toyota operations

en.title: Chinese carmakers GAC and FAW eye potential tie-up of their Toyota operations
en.summary: Chinese state-owned automakers Guangzhou Automobile Group and FAW Group are considering restructuring their joint Toyota ventures through share acquisitions, responding to Beijing's consolidation directive amid weakening domestic demand.

stories.title: Citigroup hires veteran banker Sophia Wang to lead China institutional sales

en.title: Citigroup hires veteran banker Sophia Wang to lead China institutional sales
en.summary: Citigroup appointed Sophia Wang as managing director and head of China financial-institutional sales. Based in Shanghai, she will oversee institutional sales coverage across multiple product areas as the bank expands its presence in mainland capital markets.
